summary: Request: tenant snapshot differential delivery + verifiable redaction proof for audit exports
description:
Issue summary:
FinVista requests a nightly differential snapshot of tenant-scoped audit logs (only events changed since the last snapshot) delivered to their SFTP endpoint, plus a per-file cryptographic manifest proving that PII redaction rules were applied before export. They want a sample delivery and verification steps prior to onboarding to scheduled exports.

Impact:
- Customer cannot complete their PCI evidence bundle without a demonstrable redaction proof and differential export size estimates.
- They’ve paused internal compliance sign-off pending sample delivery.

Environment:
- Redwood hosted production (us-east), tenant: finvista-prod, model traffic predominantly rw-instruct-alpha-3.

Requested deliverables (customer):
1) A sample differential export (TLS SFTP, prefixed by date) containing only events for tenant finvista-prod for 2026-03-08 to 2026-03-09.
2) A cryptographic manifest file (SHA256 checksums + signed envelope) showing the exported file(s) were processed by PII-redaction pipeline v2.1 and listing redaction rules applied (rule IDs).
3) Instructions and verification steps they can run locally to validate the manifest and checksums.
4) Expected nightly payload size (delta) and estimated retention TTL recommendations per PCI guidance.

Steps to reproduce / how they validated so far:
1) Customer provided SFTP endpoint and public key.
2) Support team attempted a scoped export test but the initial export included user_email fields in 3 records (customer provided sample).
3) Customer flagged these as PII leakage and requested a deeper audit and proof.

Logs / evidence included by customer:
- Sample event IDs: evt_20260308_89a3, evt_20260308_8fe2, evt_20260309_a3b1
- SFTP host and fingerprint (provided in secure channel).

Constraints and notes:
- FinVista requires that the redaction-proof be verifiable without exposing raw contents (manifest must not reveal redacted values).
- They prefer a solution that can be automated into nightly delivery with retention of 1 year for PCI audit.

Desired timeline:
- Sample export + manifest within 48 hours.
- Production schedule after customer validation within two weeks.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Maya Chen (Support): Initial ticket created after CS call. Added customer SFTP details to secure vault. Marking P1 due to audit window.
2026-03-10 - Ravi Patel (SRE): Acknowledged. Starting scoped export job with redaction pipeline v2.1. Will check rule coverage for email/user identifiers.
2026-03-11 - FinVista (Customer): Noted we received three records in sample that still contained user_email. Need proof those are removed before full export.

2026-03-11 - Ravi Patel (SRE): Investigating pipeline logs. Early hypothesis: a downstream transformation in the archive job bypassed redaction due to legacy field aliasing (user_email vs emailAddress).
Action: run a targeted re-export for the three event IDs and include signed manifest. ETA 2026-03-12 morning.
2026-03-12 - Maya Chen (Support): Provided preliminary verification steps to customer (how to check SHA256 and verify signature). Asked customer to confirm receipt after SFTP push.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-11: Checked audit-pipeline logs: redaction stage ran on 2026-03-09 02:15 UTC for tenant finvista-prod. No errors in stage logs.

2026-03-11: Found transformation map in archive job that renamed emailAddress->user_email; redaction rules were keyed against emailAddress. Records that passed through archive job late may have skipped redaction because rule lookup uses canonical field name.
2026-03-11: Reproduced locally by replaying event evt_20260308_89a3 through pipeline with current transforms; observed unredacted user_email when transform order set to 'archive-first'.

2026-03-11: Risk assessment: low probability of broad leakage (3 known records), but cannot rely on untreated legacy transforms. Need pipeline change or an additional safeguard in export path that enforces canonicalization before redaction.

Links: Slack #support thread: https://slack.redwood.com/support/threads/C02XYZ, Infra PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2983 (adds canonicalization shim), Confluence runbook referenced above.
resolution_notes: Work in progress. Plan: (1) Generate re-export for the three flagged events after applying canonicalization shim; (2) Produce signed manifest using key in vault (KMS signing key id: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/exports/cryptoKeys/export-sign); (3) Push sample to provided SFTP and share verification steps. If sample passes, schedule nightly differential export with 1-year retention and manifest generation. No production rollout until FinVista verifies sample.
